Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <8f507d2e.02030...@posting.google.com>, Shaun

McIsaac <smci...@onesourcecorp.com> writes:
>If Lazverinus plays torn signpost, will he have 3 strength or 5?

5. Torn Signpost sets his base strength (which on all vampires is a
default of 1) to 3. His +2 strength then applies.
